# A menu button drops a click that lands before its lazily loaded menu exists

## Context

@neo-opus-ada's defect-note (2026-09-18): `component/button/Base.spec.mjs` failed in CI three times this afternoon, on three arms, in PRs that touch no menu or button code. The runs were PR #18857 (run 35350078494, attempts 1 and 2) and PR #18873 (run 35345435248). All three stopped at the first poll after `createSubMenuButton()` + `focus()` + Enter, which expects focus on `Open` and got `null`. Locally they passed 189/189 on an idle machine.

I reproduced it locally under machine-wide load, with the component suite running on 10 workers in the background. At the moment of failure no menu is mounted and focus is still on the button: the Enter never opened anything.

## The Problem

`button.Base#afterSetMenu()` creates `menuList` inside `import('../menu/List.mjs').then(…)`. `onClick()` calls `toggleMenu()`, which reads `menuList.hidden` with no guard. A click that lands before the import resolves throws in the App Worker and is lost, and the menu never opens. That includes Enter or Space, which a native button turns into a click.

Deterministic reproduction: hold the `src/menu/List.mjs` fetch, click the button, then release. No menu opens (0 `.neo-menu-list`).

The arms caught it only under load. A user hits it on a slow device, or by clicking a button as soon as it renders.

## The Architectural Reality

- `src/button/Base.mjs`: `afterSetMenu()` (the lazy import), `onClick()`, `toggleMenu()` (`menuList.hidden` unguarded). Every other `menuList` read in the class is guarded.
- `core.Base#trap()` is the destroy-safe way for an instance to await a promise.

## The Fix

`afterSetMenu()` keeps its import promise, and `toggleMenu()` awaits it through `trap()` before toggling. A click that arrives early opens the menu once the menu exists, instead of throwing.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] A component arm holds the `menu/List.mjs` fetch, clicks the button, then releases: the menu opens. It is red on `dev`, where no menu opens.
- [ ] The button arms in the defect-note pass under the load that reproduced them.

## Out of Scope

- A `menu` config changed at runtime creates another `menuList` without destroying the previous one.
